versions.content: The CanFdPaddingValue that is used to transmit the PDU referenced by MirrorDestPduRef for a CAN-FD destination bus shall be set to 0 to ensure that the NetworkStateAvailable of a CAN status item is 0 if the status item has not been written by the Bus Mirroring module but lies in a padded region of the status frame.
